title: Integrate anydoc local document conversion into web_fetch
description: Plan only; leave open and unstarted. Add @firecrawl/anydoc as the local Rust/N-API document conversion backend inside the existing web_fetch pipeline, not as a separate extension and not as a package rename. Stage 1: add the pinned Node 20+ package and verify native platform installation. Stage 2: after the safe bounded response read, detect anydoc-supported document bytes/content types and convert DOC/DOCX, PPT/PPTX, XLS/XLSX, ODT/ODS/ODP, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and possibly PDF to Markdown; preserve direct HTML/Markdown/text/JSON, PDF/yt-dlp behavior until reviewed, and keep output untrusted. Stage 3: map anydoc coded errors, extraction metadata, output bounds, cleanup, and caller timeout/cancellation behavior through existing fetch contracts. Add deterministic fixtures for representative DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/ODT/RTF/EPUB/CSV inputs and compare representative PDF output with current pdftotext before choosing PDF ownership. Acceptance: web_fetch and source enrichment can read supported remote document URLs locally with no API key or hosted service; no separate public tool; no silent constraint loss; bun check and clean Pi pnpm install pass.

logs.msg: Planning only: evaluated @firecrawl/anydoc@0.1.6 as a local MIT Rust/N-API converter; temporary DOCX/PDF/CSV smoke and DOCX document-model/assets check passed. Selected integration inside web_fetch, not a separate extension or pi-fetch rename; hosted Firecrawl remains deferred; keep current pdftotext until PDF comparison. Task intentionally remains open and unstarted.
Implementation started: adding local anydoc conversion to the existing web_fetch pipeline, preserving current PDF/HTML/text/YouTube paths.

Implemented pinned @firecrawl/anydoc@0.1.6 local conversion in web_fetch via a worker. Added signature/content-type/extension dispatch, document metadata, AnyDoc error mapping, cancellation/timeout handling, deterministic DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/ODT/RTF/EPUB/CSV fixtures, and unsupported/failure tests. Retained pdftotext after comparing src/fixtures/sample.pdf (AnyDoc Markdown heading vs pdftotext plain text).
